text: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.

text: Absolute zero is minus 273.15 degrees Celsius, exactly.

text: Healthy human body temperature is about 37 degrees Celsius.
ref: Standard physiology: healthy resting body temperature about 37 C (textbook)

text: In a strong kettle, water can boil at 1,000 degrees.
ref: Water boils at 100 C at 1 atm. 1,000 C is off by x10

text: Standard gravity is 9.81 meters per second squared.
ref: Standard gravity g = 9.80665 m/s2, exact by definition (CGPM)

text: Earth circles the Sun in about 365 and a quarter days.

text: The Moon sits about 384,400 kilometers from Earth on average.

text: Astronauts have measured gravity on the Moon as stronger than on Earth.
ref: Moon surface gravity is about 1.62 m/s2, far WEAKER than Earth's 9.81 (invented reversal)

text: One mole holds 6.02214076 times 10 to the 23 particles, exactly.
ref: SI defining constant (BIPM): Avogadro 6.02214076 x 10^23 per mole, exact

text: The Planck constant is 6.62607015 times 10 to the minus 34 joule seconds, exactly.
ref: SI defining constant (BIPM): Planck 6.62607015 x 10^-34 joule seconds, exact

text: Since 2019, these constants are exact by definition, not measured.
ref: SI redefinition of 2019 fixed these constants exactly (BIPM)

text: One mole holds 6.02214076 times 10 to the 13 particles.
